title: Snow White
moral: Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로(합창 줄은 extra ch* 의 영어 합성), new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<queen_room|forest|house_front|house: 장면 배경(scene(key)). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출, 장면 안에서 배경을 바꿀 때는 before 에 둔다

acts.mirror:room | mirror:face:<show|hide>: 거울 방 세트(거울+왕비 mirror 자세+거울 얼굴) / 거울 얼굴 보이기·숨기기
acts.snow:enter_door | snow:eat3 | snow:sit7: 문 안으로 들어감(놀이판 3장) / 접시·컵 맛보기(냠! 꿀꺽! 냠냠!) / 일곱째 의자에 앉기(영차!) / i 번 침대에 눕기 / 창문 속 받기 자세 / 창틀 아래로 스르르
acts.door:reset | door:knock | door:open: 그림 속 문 조각(똑똑! / 삐걱 열림)
acts.table:set | beds:lay | beds:eight: 식탁+의자 일곱 / 작은 침대 일곱 두 줄 / 작은 침대 일곱+큰 침대(놀이판 8장 배치)
acts.crew:enter | crew:at:<x,y> | crew:hopOne: 일곱 난쟁이 줄(등불) 걸어 들어오기·자리·한 명 폴짝·모두 폴짝

lines.text: 옛날 어느 나라에 눈처럼 하얀 얼굴의 공주가 살았어요. 이름은 백설공주였어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.
segs: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.

lines.text: 백설공주는 마음씨가 곱고, 웃음소리가 방울처럼 또랑또랑했어요.
lines.en: Snow White had a kind heart, and her laugh rang out clear as a little bell.
segs: Snow White had a kind heart, and her laugh rang out clear as a little bell.

lines.text: 왕비에게는 무엇이든 대답하는 신기한 거울이 있었어요.
lines.en: The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.
segs: The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.

lines.text: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
lines.en: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
segs: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?

lines.text: 왕비님도 예쁘지만, 백설공주가 더 예뻐요.
lines.en: The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.
segs: The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.

lines.text: 왕비는 샘이 나서 얼굴이 빨개졌어요.
lines.en: The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.
segs: The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.

lines.text: 왕비는 발을 쿵쿵 구르며 거울을 노려보았어요.
lines.en: The queen stamped her feet, stomp, stomp, and glared at the mirror.
segs: The queen stamped her feet, stomp, stomp, and glared at the mirror.

lines.text: 내가 제일이어야 해! 사냥꾼을 불러라!
lines.en: I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!
segs: I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!

lines.text: 사냥꾼은 백설공주를 깊은 숲으로 데려갔어요.
lines.en: The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.
segs: The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.

lines.text: 숲은 깜깜하고, 나뭇가지가 삐죽삐죽 뻗어 있었어요.
lines.en: The forest was dark, and the branches stuck out this way and that, all jagged and spiky.
segs: The forest was dark, and the branches stuck out this way and that, all jagged and spiky.

lines.text: 사냥꾼의 손이 부들부들 떨렸어요.
lines.en: The hunter's hands trembled and shook.
segs: The hunter's hands trembled and shook.

lines.text: 공주님, 저는 도저히 못 하겠어요. 멀리멀리 달아나세요.
lines.en: Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.
segs: Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.

lines.text: 고맙습니다, 아저씨.
lines.en: Thank you, mister.

lines.text: 백설공주는 어두운 숲을 혼자 달리고 또 달렸어요.
lines.en: Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.
segs: Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.

lines.text: 가시덤불에 치마가 북북 걸리고, 부엉이가 부엉부엉 울었어요.
lines.en: Her skirt caught on the thorn bushes, rip, rip, and an owl hooted, hoo, hoo.
segs: Her skirt caught on the thorn bushes, rip, rip, and an owl hooted, hoo, hoo.

lines.text: 날이 저물 무렵, 백설공주는 숲속에서 아주 작은 집을 찾았어요.
lines.en: As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.
segs: As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.

lines.text: 굴뚝도 작고, 창문도 작고, 문도 아주 작았어요.
lines.en: The chimney was small, the windows were small, and the door was very small too.
segs: The chimney was small, the windows were small, and the door was very small too.

lines.text: 백설공주는 발끝을 들고 창문 안을 빼꼼 들여다보았어요.
lines.en: Snow White stood on her tiptoes and peeked, peek-a-boo, through the window.
segs: Snow White stood on her tiptoes and peeked, peek-a-boo, through the window.

lines.text: 어머, 정말 작은 집이네. 계세요? 아무도 안 계세요?
lines.en: Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?
segs: Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?

lines.text: 백설공주는 문을 똑똑 두드렸어요. 아무 대답이 없었어요.
lines.en: Snow White knocked on the door, knock, knock. There was no answer at all.
segs: Snow White knocked on the door, knock, knock. There was no answer at all.

lines.text: 삐걱, 문이 열렸어요. 집 안에는 아무도 없었어요.
lines.en: Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.
segs: Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.

lines.text: 백설공주는 살금살금 집 안으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: Snow White tiptoed, creep, creep, into the house.
segs: Snow White tiptoed, creep, creep, into the house.

lines.text: 작은 식탁 위에 작은 접시와 작은 컵이 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.
segs: On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.

lines.text: 접시도 일곱 개, 컵도 일곱 개, 작은 의자도 일곱 개였어요.
lines.en: Seven little plates, seven little cups, and seven little chairs.
segs: Seven little plates, seven little cups, and seven little chairs.

lines.text: 배가 너무 고파요. 한 접시에서 다 먹으면 미안하니까, 조금씩만 먹을게요.
lines.en: I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.
segs: I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.

lines.text: 백설공주는 접시마다 한 입씩, 컵마다 한 모금씩 먹었어요.
lines.en: Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.
segs: Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.

lines.text: 의자가 정말 작네. 조금 작지만… 영차, 앉았다!
lines.en: Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!
segs: Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!

lines.text: 하아암, 너무 졸려요.
lines.en: Haaaam, I am so sleepy.

lines.text: 백설공주는 눈을 비비며 꾸벅꾸벅 졸았어요.
lines.en: Snow White rubbed her eyes and her head began to nod, nod, nod.
segs: Snow White rubbed her eyes and her head began to nod, nod, nod.

lines.text: 방에는 작은 침대가 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.
segs: In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.

lines.text: 이 침대는 너무 짧아요. 다리가 안 펴져요.
lines.en: This bed is too short. My legs won't stretch out.
segs: This bed is too short. My legs won't stretch out.

lines.text: 이 침대는 불편해요. 발끝이 쿵 닿아요.
lines.en: This bed is uncomfortable. My toes bump the end.
segs: This bed is uncomfortable. My toes bump the end.

lines.text: 백설공주는 이 침대 저 침대 데굴데굴 굴러 보았어요.
lines.en: Snow White rolled, roly-poly, from this bed to that bed.
segs: Snow White rolled, roly-poly, from this bed to that bed.

lines.text: 몸을 동그랗게 웅크리면… 조금 작지만 포근해요. 잘 자요…
lines.en: If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...
segs: If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...

lines.text: 이불은 포근포근, 베개는 말랑말랑했어요.
lines.en: The blanket was snug and cozy, and the pillow was soft and squishy.
segs: The blanket was snug and cozy, and the pillow was soft and squishy.

lines.text: 백설공주는 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: Snow White drifted off to sleep.
segs: Snow White drifted off to sleep.

lines.text: 창밖에는 별이 반짝반짝, 집 안은 쌔근쌔근 조용했어요.
lines.en: Outside the window the stars went twinkle, twinkle, and inside the house all was quiet, with soft little breaths.
segs: Outside the window the stars went twinkle, twinkle, and inside the house all was quiet, with soft little breaths.

lines.text: 밤이 되자, 산에서 일하던 일곱 난쟁이가 집으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.
segs: At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 등불을 흔들흔들 들고, 뚜벅뚜벅 들어왔어요.
lines.en: The dwarfs came in, tromp, tromp, their lanterns swinging to and fro.
segs: The dwarfs came in, tromp, tromp, their lanterns swinging to and fro.

lines.text: 누가 내 의자에 앉았지?
lines.en: Who sat in my chair?

lines.text: 누가 내 접시에서 먹었지?
lines.en: Who ate from my plate?

lines.text: 누가 내 빵을 먹었지?
lines.en: Who ate my bread?

lines.text: 누가 내 숟가락을 썼지?
lines.en: Who used my spoon?

lines.text: 누가 내 포크를 썼지?
lines.en: Who used my fork?

lines.text: 누가 내 컵으로 마셨지?
lines.en: Who drank from my cup?

lines.text: 어? 내 침대에 누가 자고 있어!
lines.en: Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!
segs: Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!

lines.text: 와아, 정말 예쁜 아이다! 깨우지 말자, 쉿!
lines.en: Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
segs: Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!

lines.text: 아침 햇살이 창문으로 반짝 들어왔어요.
lines.en: The morning sunlight came sparkling in through the window.
segs: The morning sunlight came sparkling in through the window.

lines.text: 아침이 되자 백설공주가 눈을 떴어요.
lines.en: In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.
segs: In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.

lines.text: 깜짝이야! 저는 백설공주예요. 갈 곳이 없어요. 여기서 지내도 될까요?
lines.en: Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?
segs: Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?

lines.text: 그럼! 대신 우리가 일하러 간 사이, 낯선 사람에겐 절대 문을 열지 마!
lines.en: Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
segs: Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!

lines.text: 네, 약속할게요.
lines.en: Yes, I promise!

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 곡괭이를 메고 뚜벅뚜벅 산으로 일하러 갔어요.
lines.en: The dwarfs shouldered their pickaxes and tramped off, tromp, tromp, to work in the mountains.
segs: The dwarfs shouldered their pickaxes and tramped off, tromp, tromp, to work in the mountains.

lines.text: 백설공주는 집안일을 하고, 난쟁이들은 산에서 일했어요. 모두 사이좋게 지냈어요.
lines.en: Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.
segs: Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.

lines.text: 백설공주는 싹싹 쓸고 닦고, 보글보글 국도 끓였어요.
lines.en: Snow White swept and scrubbed, swish, swish, and cooked soup that went bubble, bubble.
segs: Snow White swept and scrubbed, swish, swish, and cooked soup that went bubble, bubble.

lines.text: 백설공주에게는 우리 침대가 너무 작아. 큰 침대를 만들어 주자!
lines.en: Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
segs: Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!

lines.text: 뚝딱뚝딱, 쿵쿵!
lines.en: Bang-bang, thump-thump!

lines.text: 작은 침대 일곱 개 옆에, 커다란 침대가 짠! 하고 놓였어요.
lines.en: Next to the seven little beds, ta-da! There stood a great big bed.
segs: Next to the seven little beds, ta-da! There stood a great big bed.

lines.text: 와아, 고맙습니다!
lines.en: Wow, thank you!

lines.text: 모두 잘 자요. 함께 지내서 행복해요.
lines.en: Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.
segs: Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.

lines.text: 그날 밤은 모두 드르렁 쿨쿨, 꿈나라로 갔어요.
lines.en: That night they all went off to dreamland, snoring, zzz, zzz.
segs: That night they all went off to dreamland, snoring, zzz, zzz.

lines.text: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
lines.en: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
segs: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?

lines.text: 숲속 일곱 난쟁이 집의 백설공주가 제일 예뻐요.
lines.en: Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.
segs: Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.

lines.text: 왕비는 부들부들 떨며 나쁜 꾀를 생각해 냈어요.
lines.en: The queen shook with anger, and she thought up a wicked plan.
segs: The queen shook with anger, and she thought up a wicked plan.

lines.text: 왕비는 할머니로 변장하고 빨간 사과를 들고 숲으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.
segs: The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.

lines.text: 사과 사세요~ 아주 맛있는 사과란다.
lines.en: Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.
segs: Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.

lines.text: 문은 열면 안 돼요. 난쟁이들과 약속했거든요.
lines.en: I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.
segs: I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.

lines.text: 그럼 창문으로 하나만 맛보렴.
lines.en: Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.
segs: Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.

lines.text: 사과는 새빨갛고 반질반질, 아주 맛있어 보였어요.
lines.en: The apple was bright red and shiny, and it looked so very yummy.
segs: The apple was bright red and shiny, and it looked so very yummy.

lines.text: 백설공주는 사과를 한 입 베어 물고, 그만 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.
segs: Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.

lines.text: 저녁에 돌아온 난쟁이들은 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.
segs: The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.

lines.text: 백설공주님, 일어나요! 일어나세요…
lines.en: Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
segs: Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 훌쩍훌쩍 울며 백설공주를 안아 들었어요.
lines.en: The dwarfs sniffled and sobbed as they gently lifted Snow White up.
segs: The dwarfs sniffled and sobbed as they gently lifted Snow White up.

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 백설공주를 맑은 유리관에 눕히고, 날마다 곁을 지켰어요.
lines.en: They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.
segs: They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.

lines.text: 유리관은 햇빛을 받아 반짝반짝 빛나고, 새들도 포르르 날아와 곁에 앉았어요.
lines.en: The glass coffin sparkled in the sunlight, and little birds fluttered down to sit beside it.
segs: The glass coffin sparkled in the sunlight, and little birds fluttered down to sit beside it.

lines.text: 어느 날, 이웃 나라 왕자님이 숲을 지나가다 백설공주를 보았어요.
lines.en: One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.
segs: One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.

lines.text: 이 공주님을 제 성으로 모셔 가 정성껏 돌보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.
segs: I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.

lines.text: 그런데 관을 옮기다가 덜컹! 목에 걸렸던 사과 조각이 툭 빠졌어요.
lines.en: But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.
segs: But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.

lines.text: 백설공주의 손가락이 꼼지락꼼지락 움직였어요.
lines.en: Snow White's fingers began to wiggle, wiggle.
segs: Snow White's fingers began to wiggle, wiggle.

lines.text: 어머, 제가 오래 잤나 봐요.
lines.en: Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.
segs: Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.

lines.text: 이제 괜찮아요. 함께 성으로 가요.
lines.en: You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.
segs: You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.

lines.text: 만세! 백설공주가 깨어났다!
lines.en: Hooray! Snow White is awake!

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 깡충깡충 뛰며 손뼉을 짝짝 쳤어요.
lines.en: The dwarfs hopped up and down and clapped their hands, clap, clap!
segs: The dwarfs hopped up and down and clapped their hands, clap, clap!

lines.text: 왕비는 멀리 떠났어요
lines.en: The queen went far, far away.
segs: The queen went far, far away.

lines.text: 낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.
lines.en: Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
segs: Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
